Frequently Asked Questions

Real questions and answers about martial arts training

Will my child become a bully?

Martial arts training is about discipline, respect and self-control. Talk with our instructor about how these values are taught and reinforced in class.

How do I start martial arts for the first time?

Start by getting in touch. Tell us who the classes are for and whether you have trained before. Our instructor can explain the available classes, what to expect and how to arrange your first visit.

What should I bring to my first martial arts lesson?

Contact the school before your visit to confirm what to wear and bring, including whether a uniform or any specific equipment is needed.

I'm not very sporty or coordinated. Can I join?

Let our instructor know your experience, goals and any concerns before joining. They can help you find a suitable starting point and explain how training progresses.

What are the class times and fees?

Call 0904 038 2955 or send a WhatsApp enquiry for the current timetable, fees and class availability. Please confirm your session before travelling to the school.

How long does it take to earn a black belt?

Progress depends on the training program, attendance and grading requirements. Ask our instructor about the syllabus and the milestones along the way.
